description: This file defines the PermissionMonitoringSupport enum with static methods to manage permission monitoring, including starting and stopping monitoring via the PermissionMonitor singleton.

classes.name: PermissionMonitoringSupport
classes.description: An enum providing static methods for permission monitoring control.

methods.name: setMonitoring
methods.description: Enables or disables permission monitoring based on the shouldMonitor flag.

methods.name: stopMonitoring
methods.description: Stops permission monitoring if it is active.
